title: Sibol Pokémon Unite squad hungry for redemption in Asian Games
summary: Sibol’s Pokémon Unite squad is looking to make its mark at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Games — and perhaps achieve what it could not at the recent Pokémon World Championships.
